positions.name: IdlessSubmissionRequiresSlugFallback
positions.frame: what must the pipeline do when a memory arrives without an explicit id field?
positions.why: src-1 establishes the triggering condition — a submission lacking an explicit id — and src-2 states the pipeline's required response to that condition (LLM id-gen or deterministic slugify fallback, then commit). Read together, one directional line runs from absence-of-id to the obligated remedy; conviction readings support this: src-1 is flat claim-level fact-setting, src-2 is decision-grade prescription, and that gradient is exactly the shape of condition-then-requirement rather than two unrelated assertions. The technical register (native pipeline jargon: 'slug', 'slugify fallback', 'id-gen') and the authority-ranking/pressure reads on src-2 both belong to this same throughline rather than marking a second, separate stance.
